title: Clear release dependency vulnerabilities
description: Audit the installed dependency graph and apply the safest compatible package/lockfile upgrades needed to remove known critical/high vulnerabilities before the native UX release. Avoid forced upgrades unless verified.
acceptance_criteria: npm audit has no critical/high findings, or any unavoidable findings are documented with exact dependency path and exposure; all repository quality gates still pass.

title: Harden native settings and marketplace
description: Handle settings persistence and marketplace network failures, add timeouts/validation/rollback/confirmation/accessibility, and focused tests.
acceptance_criteria: All store/network operations surface failure safely; remote downloads are bounded and cancellable; destructive actions confirm; controls are accessible; tests pass.
close_reason: Hardened settings and marketplace persistence/network flows, confirmation, accessibility, cancellation, and tests

title: Polish native IDE visual system and interaction
description: Introduce shared native theme/tokens and interaction primitives, improve touch targets/accessibility and mobile layout across shell, tabs, breadcrumbs, editor, diff, conflicts, and split pane, with tests and documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Native chrome supports coherent semantic theming, controls meet mobile accessibility/touch standards, destructive editor actions are safe, layouts remain compatible, and quality gates pass.
close_reason: Added semantic native theming, portable typography, accessible touch targets, dirty/destructive confirmations, safe-area/reduced-motion support, LRU panel retention, editor read-only behavior, bridge readiness, documentation, and passing tests.

title: Harden native data and Git panels
description: Add explicit loading/error/retry states, provider identity handling, safe Git operations, confirmations, accessibility, and tests for FileTreeSidebar, SearchPanel, and SourceControlPanel.
acceptance_criteria: Provider failures are visible and retryable; Git operations cannot reject silently; destructive replace is confirmed; controls are accessible; focused tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented retryable provider states, safe Git operations, Replace All confirmation, provider identity refresh, accessibility/touch sizing, semantic theme integration, and focused passing tests.

title: Harden native WebView and terminal lifecycle
description: Make ResilientWebView bridge-ready aware and generation-safe; prevent terminal session leaks and surface terminal I/O errors; add focused tests.
acceptance_criteria: WebView readiness reflects embedded app readiness; stale events cannot hide failures; terminal sessions are opened/closed idempotently across remounts; all promise failures are handled; tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented generation-safe bridge readiness and idempotent terminal session lifecycle with surfaced I/O failures, reconnect UX, accessibility, theme tokens, and 17 focused passing tests.

title: Ship native IDE UX and robustness release
description: Implement the full native IDE audit: robust async/error states, resilient terminal/WebViews, safe destructive actions, accessible mobile visual system, comprehensive tests, and a verified tagged npm release.
acceptance_criteria: All native findings are addressed, quality gates and package smoke tests pass, changes are committed, and an explicitly selected release tag is pushed to trigger npm publishing.

title: Audit native IDE visual UX and robustness
description: Review packages/native for aesthetic and UX improvements, code robustness, error handling, accessibility, performance, and test gaps. Produce an evidence-based prioritized report without changing implementation.
acceptance_criteria: A prioritized audit identifies concrete findings with file references, impact, and recommended remediation across visual design, UX, robustness, and error handling.
notes: Audit found priority themes: provider errors are silently converted to empty/loading states; Git and terminal async actions have uncaught rejection paths; terminal sessions can leak on resilient WebView remount; settings/marketplace persistence failures are unhandled; destructive replace/conflict/theme actions lack confirmation or rollback; most controls lack accessibility semantics and 44dp targets; visual system is hard-coded dark with inconsistent typography; only FileViewerHost and ResilientWebView have native tests.
close_reason: Completed source-based native IDE audit with prioritized UX, visual, robustness, error-handling, and test recommendations.

title: Document repository guidance for coding agents
description: Inspect the repository structure, tooling, architecture, conventions, and workflows, then create a root AGENTS.md containing accurate instructions for coding agents.
acceptance_criteria: A root AGENTS.md documents project layout, setup, validation commands, architectural boundaries, coding conventions, and Beads workflow, all verified against repository files.
close_reason: Created and validated root AGENTS.md with repository-specific architecture, workflow, validation, and release guidance.
